name: instant-provisioner — hot-pool reaper failing to reclaim 'failed' pool_items (reap error rate > 0 sustained 30m)
description: P2 observability/abuse warning. instant_pool_reap_total{outcome IN (deprovision_err, delete_err)} > 0 sustained for >30 minutes. The hot-pool reaper (provisioner sweep #8 maintenance loop) found a 'failed' pool_item but could not fully reclaim it: outcome='deprovision_err' = the backend Deprovision call errored and the row was left for the next 30s tick; outcome='delete_err' = Deprovision succeeded but the pool_items row DELETE failed. A single transient blip self-heals on the next tick; a sustained rate means the reaper is wedged and 'failed' pool infra (customer DBs, Redis ACL users, NATS accounts) is accumulating unreclaimed — a slow capacity and cost leak. Runbook: kubectl logs the instant-provisioner pod for `pool.reapStale` errors, then walk the resource_type / outcome labels to the targeted backend's /healthz. Source: provisioner/internal/pool/manager.go (reapStale), metric declared in provisioner/internal/pool/metrics.go (poolReapTotal).

nrql.query: SELECT sum(instant_pool_reap_total) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'instant_pool_reap_total' AND outcome IN ('deprovision_err', 'delete_err') FACET resource_type, outcome
